subject: bus
source: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies (0450) syllabus (2023–2026 exams) and its successor Cambridge IGCSE Business (0264) for examination in 2027, 2028 and 2029 (content largely unchanged) — Cambridge International; Year 10 covers sections 1–3

weeks.topic: The purpose of business activity: needs, wants, scarcity and opportunity cost
objectives: Explain the concepts of needs, wants, scarcity and opportunity cost
Explain the purpose of business activity

weeks.topic: Specialisation and adding value
objectives: Explain the benefits and drawbacks of specialisation and the division of labour
Explain how businesses add value

weeks.topic: Classification of businesses: economic sectors and public and private sectors
objectives: Classify businesses into primary, secondary and tertiary sectors
Explain reasons for changes in sector importance
Compare public and private sector businesses

weeks.topic: Enterprise, entrepreneurs and business plans
objectives: Describe the characteristics of successful entrepreneurs
Explain the contents and uses of a business plan
Explain how governments support start-ups

weeks.topic: Measuring business size and why businesses want to grow
objectives: Compare methods of measuring business size
Explain why owners want to expand

weeks.topic: Internal and external growth: mergers and takeovers
objectives: Distinguish internal and external growth
Explain horizontal, vertical and conglomerate integration

weeks.topic: Why some businesses stay small and why businesses fail
objectives: Explain why some businesses remain small
Analyse common causes of business failure

weeks.topic: Types of business organisation: sole traders and partnerships
objectives: Explain the features, advantages and disadvantages of sole traders and partnerships
Explain unlimited liability

weeks.topic: Private and public limited companies and limited liability
objectives: Compare private and public limited companies
Explain limited liability and the separation of ownership and control

weeks.topic: Franchises, joint ventures and public sector corporations
objectives: Explain the advantages of franchises for franchisor and franchisee
Explain joint ventures
Describe public corporations

weeks.topic: Business objectives and their importance
objectives: Explain the importance of setting objectives
Describe objectives such as survival, growth, profit and market share
Explain social enterprise objectives

weeks.topic: Stakeholder roles, objectives and conflicts
objectives: Identify internal and external stakeholders
Explain stakeholder objectives and how they may conflict

weeks.topic: Motivating employees: importance and Maslow's hierarchy of needs
objectives: Explain why motivated workers are important
Apply Maslow's hierarchy of needs

weeks.topic: Motivation theories: Taylor and Herzberg
objectives: Explain Taylor's scientific management
Apply Herzberg's two-factor theory

weeks.topic: Review: understanding business activity and motivation
objectives: Revise business types, objectives and stakeholders
Practise short-answer and calculation questions

weeks.topic: Financial and non-financial methods of motivation
objectives: Compare wages, salaries, bonuses and commission
Explain job rotation, job enlargement, job enrichment and teamwork

weeks.topic: Organisation structure: charts, span of control and chain of command
objectives: Interpret organisation charts
Explain span of control, chain of command and delegation

weeks.topic: The role of management and leadership styles
objectives: Describe the functions of managers
Compare autocratic, democratic and laissez-faire leadership

weeks.topic: Trade unions
objectives: Explain the role of trade unions
Analyse the benefits and drawbacks for employees and employers

weeks.topic: Recruitment and selection
objectives: Describe job analysis, job descriptions and person specifications
Compare internal and external recruitment
Describe selection methods

weeks.topic: Training and full-time and part-time employees
objectives: Compare induction, on-the-job and off-the-job training
Explain the benefits of full-time and part-time workers

weeks.topic: Reducing the workforce and legal controls on employment
objectives: Distinguish dismissal and redundancy
Explain legal controls on contracts, discrimination, health and safety and minimum wage

weeks.topic: Internal and external communication
objectives: Explain why effective communication matters
Compare written, verbal and electronic methods

weeks.topic: Barriers to effective communication
objectives: Identify communication barriers
Suggest ways to overcome them

weeks.topic: The role of marketing, changing customer needs and competition
objectives: Explain the role of marketing
Explain why customer spending patterns change
Explain customer loyalty and relationships

weeks.topic: Market segmentation and niche and mass markets
objectives: Explain how markets are segmented
Compare niche and mass markets

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: business activity, people in business and marketing basics
objectives: Complete timed short-answer and data-response papers
Use business terms accurately in answers

weeks.topic: Market research: primary and secondary methods
objectives: Compare primary and secondary research methods
Explain sampling methods and accuracy of research

weeks.topic: Presenting and interpreting market research data
objectives: Draw and interpret tables, charts and graphs
Analyse market research results

weeks.topic: Marketing mix: product, branding and the product life cycle
objectives: Explain product development and branding
Draw and apply the product life cycle and extension strategies

weeks.topic: Marketing mix: pricing methods and price elasticity
objectives: Compare cost-plus, competitive, penetration, skimming and promotional pricing
Explain price elasticity of demand

weeks.topic: Marketing mix: place and distribution channels
objectives: Compare distribution channels
Explain the growth of e-commerce

weeks.topic: Marketing mix: promotion
objectives: Explain the aims of promotion
Compare advertising media and sales promotion methods
Explain the role of the marketing budget

weeks.topic: Technology and the marketing mix
objectives: Explain the use of the internet and social media in marketing
Analyse the benefits and drawbacks of e-commerce

weeks.topic: Marketing strategy and entering foreign markets
objectives: Justify a marketing strategy for a given situation
Explain the opportunities and problems of selling abroad

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: understanding business, people and marketing
objectives: Complete a case-study style paper
Analyse and evaluate business decisions

weeks.topic: Review: marketing and human resources
objectives: Correct errors from end-of-year exams
Consolidate key definitions before Year 11
